title: Execution-grounded verification — never treat cannot-verify as verified
description:
Factory self-improvement loops (06/07 factory-factory, ouroboros) risk compounding errors when SpecVerifier treats “cannot verify” as “verified” (Ouroboros #1991). Current pipelines only shape-check JSON; no adversarial tester runs tool traces. SOTA (ACE, STaR/ReST) shows continual gain only with execution-grounded signals.

Context: Notion audit 2026-08-18 + Codex #37278 trajectory-reliability failures. Need bounded verifier after every round, already partially added in hardening ef9f271 but not covering cannot-verify case explicitly.
design: Add pipelines/verify_execution.py that replays tool-call traces where possible (bash/read_file subset, synthetic freespan, msgpack split) and returns verified/inconclusive/failed. Inconclusive ≠ verified. Integrate into round_txn publish gate: publish fails if any record is inconclusive without explicit human override. Mirror Codex #37278 mitigation (preserve native command output in transcripts).
acceptance_criteria: New verifier exists, is invoked in round_txn publish path; fixture with unverifiable assertion returns verified=false and blocks publish; marker-based frontier does not advance on inconclusive; docs mention never-treating cannot-verify as verified.

title: Harden validator to true schema + reward-math + spike-order (SOTA gap #1)
description:
Current pipelines/validate_run.py only checks that 6 top-level keys exist and are objects plus decision enum. schemas/thalamic-trajectory.schema.json declares every field as type:object, so “parses = training-ready” illusion. Strict audit (training_audit.py) already catches 5 unsorted Bridge events, 510 reward keys/140 shapes, provenance gaps, but pre-generation validator does not.

Context: Multi-subagent audit cloned both .claude and .agents skills, sampled outputs/raw/2026-08-17 (189 recs) and r02→r03 densification. Codex/GPT SOTA shows filtering is value, not generation; GPT-5.5 does 40% fewer tokens — need quality gate before volume.
design: Flesh out thalamic-trajectory.schema.json (require provenance.kind, reward_components.total, spike_events[*].t_rel_ms, meta.round, decision rationale). Enforce in validator: total == sum(components) within epsilon, spike_events globally non-decreasing, provenance.kind ∈ {designed,simulated,hil,unknown} at generation, reject sim_or_real:real. Add to pipelines/validate_run.py or new pipelines/check_records.py; seed fixtures that fail each new rule. See notion audit section inserted 2026-08-18.
acceptance_criteria: Schema requires provenance.kind + total + sorted spikes; validator rejects fixtures for (a) reward math mismatch, (b) unsorted spike_events, (c) sim_or_real:real, (d) missing meta.round; existing 189 legacy records flagged by strict audit remain flagged (no silent pass); new transactionally-published round passes new validator.

title: Run strict audit, sampled review, and curated promotion gate
description: Integrate the six curation lanes into one brand-new cleaned destination, run all structural and corpus-level gates, record a stratified human-review sample, and promote to a new curated destination only when every blocker is cleared.
acceptance_criteria: Full tests pass; strict audit reports training_ready true; no exact duplicates or canonical ID collisions; a factory-kind-decision stratified sample is reviewed and recorded; promotion refuses existing destinations; final manifest includes hashes, transform versions, exclusions, and counts.

title: Rebuild or exclude the nineteen impure preference comparisons
description: Implement preference curation that enforces identical state and proposed action between chosen and rejected sides. Repair only when a lossless same-context reconstruction is supported; otherwise exclude with an explicit reason and preserved source reference.
acceptance_criteria: Every retained preference pair has byte-equivalent canonical state and proposal across both sides; all nineteen known impure pairs are repaired or excluded with reason codes; no raw file changes; preference context purity is 100 percent in strict audit fixtures.
notes: Worker Ramanujan launched as 01a012ef-2c10-7943-a72e-1ac16fe8a08f; coordinator retains closure authority.

title: Normalize canonical IDs and provenance in a versioned cleaned dataset
description: Create the curation spine that assigns deterministic canonical top-level IDs and canonical provenance without rewriting raw data. Emit a reversible source-to-cleaned mapping and make reruns byte-stable.
acceptance_criteria: Every retained record has a unique deterministic top-level ID; every expected trajectory state has canonical provenance; mappings record source path, line, original ID forms, transform version, and output ID; reruns are idempotent; cross-factory collision tests pass.
notes: Worker Kierkegaard launched as 01a012ef-295e-71b3-ad99-3251a58d446f; coordinator retains closure authority.

title: Repair or quarantine the five unsorted Bridge r02-r03 pairs
description: Implement a deterministic bridge curation lane for the five known globally unsorted event streams. Preserve raw bytes, distinguish safe stable sorting from semantically ambiguous timing, and quarantine rather than guess when intent cannot be recovered.
acceptance_criteria: Raw files remain byte-identical; all five known failures are deterministically repaired or quarantined with reason codes; retained spike streams are globally non-decreasing; mappings preserve source file and line; targeted tests and strict audit fixtures pass.
notes: Worker Nietzsche launched as 01a012ef-2704-7b83-9ab4-170ec0ef6d97; coordinator retains closure authority.

title: Curate the 2026-08-17 synthetic corpus to strict training readiness
description: Produce a versioned cleaned corpus from immutable raw evidence, resolve all strict-audit blockers, preserve reversible provenance, and promote only after automated and sampled human review gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: All six curation children are closed; strict audit reports training_ready true on a new cleaned destination; an immutable source-to-output manifest exists; sampled review is recorded; curated promotion uses a brand-new destination.
notes:
First curation wave launched with five bounded specialist agents; tag normalization remains queued.
Coordinator baseline before worker integration: raw tree digest 0cb013900a8c8a85c03ecb58f7f844e67ed7ddf90e00d78d83b1290f57dbafc7 across 158 files and 6915820 bytes; unittest baseline 80/80 passing.

title: Rasters everywhere + spike-implemented gate for SNN distillation
description:
Neuromorphic bridge (03) and ttf currently emit spike counts/margins (e.g., 366 vs 301, margin 0.097) not rasters. Only ttf-r03-019 and ffpc spike model give true rasters (20-50ms excerpts) + third-factor routing (τe 2.0s, eligibility). Loihi 2 reference (128 cores/131k neurons/130M synapses, 1ms barrier) needs ISI/refractory/adaptation to distill; gate head is never spike-implemented per NOTES-r03 gap #6.

Context: audit of 39 bridge pairs (34/39 sorted, 2155 events); Codex/GPT SOTA + Conabio neuromorphic census shows distillation requires execution-grounded spike data.
design: Require per-record 20-50ms spike raster excerpt (neuron_id, t_us) + per-population third-factor routing table where neuromorphic. Add one spike-implemented gate episode per window (neuron counts, thresholds, decision windows) per NOTES-r03 next-steps #6. Extend schemas/reward-ontology to include raster sidecar; validate spikes = neurons*rate*window @23pJ where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: New NELB/TTF round contains raster excerpt per record + routing table; at least one gate-as-SNN record exists with neuron/threshold spec; training_audit checks raster presence and spike-product; SNN distillation probe can load rasters without parsing prose counts.

title: Independent preference arms — generate rejected/chosen in isolated sessions
description:
Failure-as-fuel (05) currently generates (failed → diagnosis → repaired → preference) in one context, producing correlated DPO pairs. 19/42 pairs already impure (state/proposal drift) per strict audit; sf-c5l.3 will fix legacy but future generation will reintroduce correlation. SOTA: sophisticated rephrased data without degradation needs diversity; single-context chosen/rejected is the textbook collapse vector.

Context: audit sampled prompts/05 + outputs/raw ffpc batch-r02/r03; cf. Notion audit gap #3 monoculture.
design: Change 05 workflow: session A generates rejected + diagnosis; session B (fresh context, only diagnosis + original state/proposal as input) generates chosen. Enforce same canonical state/proposal via sf-c5l.3 purity gate at publish. Add embedding distance check between arms (distance > threshold) to ensure not verbatim copy. Document in prompts/05.
acceptance_criteria: New ffpc round produced via two isolated sessions; strict audit reports 100% preference purity on new round; embedding distance between arms > threshold fixture passes; single-session generation path is deprecated in docs.

title: Replace legacy coding thought fields with observable decision basis
description: Curate the three legacy coding episodes so training output contains concise observable decision_basis evidence rather than hidden thought. Preserve raw episodes unchanged and document exclusion when an observable basis cannot be derived safely.
acceptance_criteria: No curated coding step exposes a thought field; every retained step has a concise decision_basis grounded in visible plan, tool call, observation, or reflection; all 77 legacy steps are migrated or excluded with reason codes; audit fixtures pass.
notes: Worker Sagan launched as 01a012ef-2f94-7f02-a5ef-5936caf99706; coordinator retains closure authority.

title: Define and implement a canonical reward ontology and conversion policy
description: Define reward ontology v1 and a conservative conversion policy for the 510 source keys and 140 shapes. Separate sign or order only evidence from magnitude-comparable rewards and preserve all source components in reversible sidecars.
acceptance_criteria: A versioned ontology and machine-readable mapping exist; every retained record declares its reward comparability class; magnitude mixing is impossible for uncalibrated records; source rewards remain recoverable; arithmetic and conversion tests pass.
notes: Worker Lagrange launched as 01a012ef-2e94-76b0-a978-fa4a2c2d89f4; coordinator retains closure authority.

title: Quality gate before volume — dedup + ~30/70 synthetic/real mix enforcement
description:
Factory optimizes for volume (expanding until stop) before enforcing dedup or synthetic/real ratio. SOTA ‘Demystifying Synthetic Data’ (>1000 LLMs) finds optimal ~30% rephrased synthetic /70% real; crude synthetic collapses. Current promote has no embedding dedup or ratio gate; cleaned tree still has 510 reward keys/140 shapes drift implying distributional imbalance.

Extends sf-c5l.7 promotion gate: need execution queue item to enforce.
design: Add pipelines/quality_gate.py: embedding dedup (cosine >0.97 near-duplicate exclusion), reward-shape entropy check, provenance ratio check. Gate promotion to outputs/curated only if synthetic/real mix within policy (configurable, default 30/70) and no duplicates. Emit sidecar with duplicate clusters and mix report.
acceptance_criteria: Quality gate exists and is called in promote path; fixture with duplicate records is excluded with reason; curated manifest includes mix ratio and duplicate report; docs state 30/70 guidance with reference to SOTA study.

title: Token-efficient windows + early-stop on coverage convergence
description:
Continuous workflow burns ~3M tokens/2h per 20-round window then hits session limit (Codex hard limit). No early-stop on coverage convergence; allocation is open-ended “until told to stop”. GPT-5.5 Codex achieves 40% fewer tokens, 400K context — factory is ~1.6x more expensive than SOTA baseline per round. Need economics fix before next Fable session.

Context: Notion audit gap #4, historical 342 attempts/281 errored largely session-limit exhaustion, 9.2M tokens measured.
design: Set defaults to 40%-fewer-token regime (shorter prompts, denser JSONL, no verbose prose in batch files). Add coverage-novelty metric (embedding distance vs last 2 NOTES) and stop window when 2 consecutive NOTES report <5% novel coverage. Wire into .claude/skills/run-synthetic-factory driver.py + workflow max-rounds backstop.
acceptance_criteria: Driver exposes --token-efficient flag or equivalent; new window uses ~40% fewer tokens per record vs 2026-08-17 baseline on matched quota; early-stop fires on synthetic convergence fixture; session-limit kill no longer the dominant error class in next window.

title: Normalize the synthetic corpus tag vocabulary
description: Replace the 2790 string free-form tag surface with a compact versioned controlled taxonomy. Preserve original tags in reversible provenance and map unknown or one-off labels without silently inventing semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A controlled taxonomy and deterministic mapping exist; retained records use only canonical tags; original tags remain recoverable; unmapped tags are reported explicitly; vocabulary entropy and idempotence tests pass.
